name: Black Belt
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This belt helps with focus and boosts the power of the holder's Fighting-type moves by 20%.

name: Black Glasses
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a pair of shady- looking glasses that boost the power of the holder's Dark-type moves by 20%.

name: Bright Powder
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This glittery powder casts a tricky glare that lowers the accuracy of opposing Pokémon's moves.

name: Charcoal
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a combustible fuel that boosts the power of the holder's Fire-type moves by 20%.

name: Choice Scarf
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious scarf boosts the holder's Speed stat but only allows the use of a single move.

name: Dragon Fang
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This hard, sharp fang boosts the power of the holder's Dragon-type moves by 20%.

name: Fairy Feather
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This feather, which gleams faintly when hit by light, boosts the power of the holder's Fairy-type moves by 20%.

name: Focus Band
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder is hit with a move that should knock it out, it may be able to endure with 1 HP.

name: Focus Sash
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder has full HP and it is hit with a move that should knock it out, it will endure with 1 HP—but only once.

name: Hard Stone
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a durable stone that boosts the power of the holder's Rock-type moves by 20%.

name: King's Rock
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the target to flinch whenever the holder successfully inflicts damage on them with an attack.

name: Leftovers
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It slowly but steadily restores the holder's HP.

name: Light Ball
description: An item to be held by Pikachu. It's a mysterious orb that boosts Pikachu's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

name: Magnet
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a powerful magnet that boosts the power of the holder's Electric-type moves by 20%.

name: Mental Herb
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will be able to shake off move-binding effects to move freely — but only once.

name: Metal Coat
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a special metallic coating that boosts the power of the holder's Steel-type moves by 20%.

name: Miracle Seed
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a seed imbued with life force that boosts the power of the holder's Grass-type moves by 20%.

name: Mystic Water
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This teardrop-shaped gem boosts the power of the holder's Water-type moves by 20%.

name: Never-Melt Ice
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a heat-repelling piece of ice that boosts the power of the holder's Ice- type moves by 20%.

name: Poison Barb
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This small poisonous barb boosts the power of the holder's Poison-type moves by 20%.

name: Quick Claw
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This light, sharp claw lets the holder occasionally unleash a move faster than it usually would.

name: Scope Lens
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder's critical-hit ratio.

name: Sharp Beak
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a long, sharp beak that boosts the power of the holder's Flying-type moves by 20%.

name: Shell Bell
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder restores a little HP to itself every time it inflicts damage with an attack.

name: Silk Scarf
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of the holder's Normal-type moves.

name: Silver Powder
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a shiny silver powder that boosts the power of the holder's Bug-type moves by 20%.

name: Soft Sand
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This loose, silky sand boosts the power of the holder's Ground-type moves by 20%.

name: Spell Tag
description: It's a sinister, eerie tag that boosts the power of the holder's Ghost-type moves by 20%.

name: Twisted Spoon
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This spoon is imbued with telekinetic energy and boosts the power of the holder's Psychic-type moves by 20%.

name: White Herb
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle—but only once.

name: Roseli Berry
description: Halves the damage taken when the holder is hit with a supereffective Fairy-type move. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.

name: Chople Berry
description: Halves the damage taken when the holder is hit with a supereffective Fighting-type move. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.

name: Sitrus Berry
description: Restores 1/4 of the holder's max HP when the holder's HP drops to 1/2 or less of its max. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.

name: Lum Berry
description: Cures any status condition or confusion. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.

name: Mental Herb
description: Cures the holder of the Infatuated, Taunted, Unable to Repeat, Move Disabled, Healing Prevented, and Encore statuses. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.

name: White Herb
description: Restores the holder's stats to their usual value when they are lowered. Disappears for the duration of the battle after a single use.
